title: NetworkHealth win/lose/drain has ZERO test coverage (P0 health/loss + the MVP win condition)
evidence:
network_health.gd:
			var severity: int = balance.win_uptime_pct - recent_uptime
			var drain: int = clampi(severity / 10, 1, balance.meter_drain_per_tick_max)
			meter_pct = maxi(0, meter_pct - drain)
...
		if surge_uptime >= balance.win_uptime_pct:
			won = true
...
	if meter_pct <= 0 and not won:
		lost = true

run_tests.gd (full suite list — no health/win/lose suite):
	var suite_paths: Array[String] = [
		"res://tests/core/test_parse_gate.gd",
		"res://tests/core/test_catalogs.gd",
		"res://tests/core/test_qos.gd",
		"res://tests/core/test_demand.gd",
		"res://tests/core/test_director.gd",
		"res://tests/core/test_topology.gd",
		"res://tests/core/test_routing.gd",

detail: update() implements AC-E16 drain, AC-E17 precedence, and the FR12 surge-window win — the MVP pass/fail. No test asserts won/lost/meter; a win-condition regression ships silently.
recommended_fix: Add a headless suite driving breach→drain→lost and surge→win; assert meter drains only post-grace, lost supersedes, won fires when surge-end uptime ≥ threshold.

title: Replay-equality keystone runs on a no-pipe topology — routing/traversal/QoS determinism never exercised
evidence:
run_state.gd (bootstrap spawns nodes only, draws no pipes — grep for apply_edit/DrawPipeCmd/_add_pipe in run_state.gd = no matches):
static func _bootstrap_map(s: RunState) -> void:
	s.topology.spawn_node(CoreConst.NodeKind.TERMINAL, &"content_host",
		CoreConst.TerminalRole.CONTENT_HOST, Vector2i(30, 14), 40, 0)

run_tests loads test_replay.gd, whose header calls it "the determinism spine's keystone test" and whose own comment admits:
	# (Fingerprints can converge in the degenerate no-pipes case because the rng-
	# dependent dst picks don't affect the drop aggregates, so rng state is the honest
	# signal here.)
detail: Every spawned packet drops 'unreachable' on the empty graph, so BFS routing, bandwidth traversal, and lane serving never run — their determinism is unverified by the keystone test.
recommended_fix: Add a replay-equality variant that draws pipes and steps past delivery so routing/traversal/QoS divergence surfaces in the snapshot fingerprint.

title: node_health_states (🟡/🔴 warning surface, '🔴 traceable to measured strain') untested
detail: The S2 warning surface (E3.3) and the 'critical must trace to measured load' invariant (GDD-inv, FR11) have no test — a phantom-🔴 or threshold-off regression ships silently.
recommended_fix: Add a test loading a node past strain/critical thresholds and asserting STRAINED/CRITICAL map to the measured utilization (and HEALTHY at zero load).

title: Advisory test gate: FAIL
evidence: Per the lens gate thresholds (FAIL if P0<100% OR P1<80% OR overall<80%). P0 critical paths: health/loss 0% covered (NetworkHealth untested), QoS-priority behavior ~25% (only allocate() covered — promote/demote, drop ladder AC-E9, no-starvation AC-E7, pool AC-E22 untested), determinism partial (replay-equality keystone runs on a no-pipe graph, per its own comment). P1 ≈50% (severance AC-E1, QoS contention behaviors, SLA-uptime aggregation all NONE). Overall behavioral coverage <80%.
detail: P0 is not 100% (health/loss 0%, QoS-priority behavior ~25%, determinism partial) and P1 is well under 80%, so the prototype's critical paths — the win condition and the QoS differentiator — are not test-locked.
recommended_fix: Add suites for NetworkHealth win/lose, QoS priority under contention, and a wired-topology replay-equality; that lifts P0 to 100% and P1 above 80% to reach CONCERNS/PASS.
